Subject: Follow-up: procurement intake & decision-owner confirmation

Hi Samantha — thanks again for the call this morning. Quick recap and asks so we can keep momentum on the pilot procurement: 

- Economic buyer / final approver: can you confirm whether this is Samantha Lee (CFO) or someone in Operations? We heard that Procurement routes to Finance but final sign-off may sit with the CFO.
- PO timeline: when does Calyx typically issue a PO after SOW acceptance? Ballpark windows are fine (e.g., 2–4 weeks vs. 6+ weeks).
- Bill-to / invoicing: who will be the billing owner and preferred email for invoices? Do you require a tax ID or W-9 prior to onboarding?
- Security & vendor packet: we can share our vendor packet (W-9, certs, SOC 2 summary). What specific artifacts does Procurement need to accept a new SaaS vendor?

Attached is the vendor onboarding form we typically fill out. I also attached the draft SOW for the pilot (scope / billing) — please treat as draft until we align on payment terms.

Next steps I propose: 1) you confirm the PO owner and required docs, 2) we send completed vendor packet + W-9, 3) if helpful we set a 30-min intake with your procurement admin to walk through the packet and timeline.

Thanks — happy to hop on a brief call later today if useful.

Best,
Marissa
Enterprise Account Executive
Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com

From: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@calyxhealth.com>

Subject: Re: Follow-up: procurement intake & decision-owner confirmation

Thanks Marissa — good summary. Quick answers: 

- Economic buyer: final sign-off will be me (Samantha) for any annual commitment over $50k. For pilots under that threshold, Ops lead (Michael Owen) approves.
- PO timeline: once the SOW is finalized and we have required vendor docs, Procurement typically issues a PO within 10 business days. If legal review is needed it can add 1–2 weeks.
- Invoicing: billing owner is finance@calyxhealth.com; we require a completed W-9 and the vendor tax ID before the first invoice.
- Vendor artifacts: Procurement wants a completed vendor intake form (please use our template), W-9, SOC 2 summary, and a Data Processing Addendum if data is customer-owned.

Can you send the W-9 and a one-page SOC summary? Also, please confirm whether Redwood will accept a 30-day net invoice term or needs a different cadence.

Samantha
CFO | Calyx Health
Samantha.Lee@calyxhealth.com

Marissa — thanks for the upload and timeline. A couple of procurement-specific asks before we can route to Finance for PO issuance: 

- Please complete our vendor intake spreadsheet (I attached our template) with primary contact, remit address, EIN/tax id, and vendor bank remit info (ACH details or remit-to address).
- We will need an executed W-9 (signed) or a scanned copy; unsigned PDF is OK if it includes the EIN.
- Any public SOC 2 attestations should include the report date and auditor name; a summary is fine if you cannot share the full report.
- Confirm Redwood's standard payment terms and whether you can accept PO matching in the invoice body.

Once we have those items we will route for Finance's PO issuance (target 10 business days from receipt). If legal requires a DPA redline we will route separately — Michael will advise.

Procurement Admin
